guideSections.title: Percentage Concepts & Overview
guideSections.title_es: Conceptos de Porcentaje y Visión General
guideSections.content_html_en: A percentage represents a fraction or ratio expressed as a fraction of 100. It is denoted using the percent sign (%). Percentages are fundamentally used to compare relative quantities.
guideSections.content_html: Un porcentaje representa una fracción o razón expresada como parte de 100 (%). Permite comparar magnitudes relativas de forma sencilla.

guideSections.title: Real-World Applications
guideSections.content_html_en:
• Discounts & Sales: Calculating 20% off an original price.
  • Taxes & Tips: Adding 15% tip or sales tax to a bill.
  • Interest Rates: Annual interest growth on savings or credit cards.
guideSections.content_html:
• Descuentos: Calcular el 20% de rebaja sobre un precio inicial.
  • Propinas e Impuestos: Añadir el IVA o propina a una factura.
  • Tipos de Interés: Rendimiento o recargo porcentual.

guideSections.title: Common Mistakes & Pitfalls
guideSections.content_html_en: Adding percentages directly: A 10% increase followed by a 10% decrease does NOT return you to the original number. For example, 100 + 10% = 110; 110 - 10% = 99.
guideSections.content_html: Sumar porcentajes directamente: Un aumento del 10% seguido de un descuento del 10% NO devuelve la cifra original. Ejemplo: 100 + 10% = 110; 110 - 10% = 99.

guideSections.title: Mathematical Formulas
guideSections.content_html_en:
Percentage of Total: Result = (Percent / 100) × Total
What Percent: Percent = (Part / Total) × 100
Percentage Change: Variation = [(Final - Initial) / |Initial|] × 100
guideSections.content_html:
Porcentaje de un total: Resultado = (Porcentaje / 100) × Total
Qué porcentaje representa: Porcentaje = (Parte / Total) × 100
Variación porcentual: Variación = [(Final - Inicial) / |Inicial|] × 100
